transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: cost_usd is copied when it is a non-negative finite number, including 0. A missing or negative value omits costUsd.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: The event does not set cost coverage, burnPerHour, or a series.

transforms.name: runtime-priceUsageUpdates-before-reduce
transforms.effect: Runtime priceUsageUpdates runs before reduceMonitorAccumulator. Reported nonnegative costUsd, including zero, wins. Otherwise exact catalog pricing. A failed estimate writes no costUsd.

transforms.name: catalog-or-provider-cost
transforms.effect: Live/correction allowed-origin usage upserts with canonical/pricing/costUsd: valid reported nonnegative USD incl zero wins; otherwise exact request model/catalog/buckets/tier pricing. Missing metadata is not reconstructed from row/session model. Failed estimate has no USD.

transforms.name: core-reduce-copies-costUsd
transforms.effect: After pricing, reduce copies costUsd onto the monitor usage value. It does not price.

transforms.name: backend-costOf
transforms.effect: costOf returns no cost object when history.total is undefined. That is cost_missing, not a present coverage of unavailable.
